① Connectionnot connected

Keys live in this browser only (localStorage), sent direct to each provider.

Both Replicate (animation, WhisperX) and OpenAI (image generation) block browser-direct calls due to CORS. Deploy proxy.worker.js (in this project) to Cloudflare Workers, set REPLICATE_API_TOKEN + OPENAI_API_KEY as secrets, paste the Worker URL here. ~5 minutes; the keys never touch the browser. (Beta: a single Worker URL replaces the alpha's separate Replicate-only Worker. The same URL routes /openai/* and /v1/* to the right provider.)

⑤ Image generation (Beta)gpt-image-2

OpenAI image generation via the Worker proxy. Refs (hero, villain, world) come from the 🎨 Bible; the per-spread panel adds the scene brief.

② Generatorsimage + audio

Each generator runs on the selected spreads (skipping anything already done). Dependency order is automatic: image → audio + sound design (parallel) → animation (after image approved).

By default, image generation skips spreads that already have an image (only re-runs on rejected). Tick this to force regeneration — useful for re-running with a new bible / scene-anchor system / refined prompts. The new generation auto-approves and overwrites the previous image.

③ Spread overview—

Status per spread per asset. Click a row's number to jump to that spread's narration view.

🎨 Project Bible

Drives every prompt-based generator (image, motion, emotion tags, sound design). Edit once, propagates everywhere. Bundled with .book exports.

① Style anchor0 chars

The visual-style declaration injected into every image, motion, and sound-design prompt. Be specific (medium, lighting, palette, references).

② Negative prompt0 chars

What the image generator should AVOID. Comma-separated.

③ Production locks0 chars

Hard constraints that survive across spreads — format, age hierarchy, continuity rules, color discipline. Distilled from your full rulebook.

④ Characters0 characters

Each character has a canonical description + one reference image. The Generate-Image flow attaches refs of characters present in the spread (you tag them per spread in ⑤ Image generation).

⑤ Overview sheets (multi-character refs)0 sheets

Project-level lineup sheets (hero ensemble, villain roster, world maps). gpt-image-2 disambiguates much better from a single multi-character sheet than from N separate single-character refs. Auto-attached when any covered character is in the scene (substitutes for the individual character refs).

⑥ Phases0 phases

Story phases (color world, mood) — used to vary palette across the book and to group selections in the 🎯 Produce tab. Phases must reference the CURRENT spread count: re-derive ranges after Apply split.

📜 Manuscript

Source-of-truth narrative. Spreads are derived from beats split out of this text. Edit the manuscript → re-split to update spreads (existing assets preserved).

① Full text0 chars · 0 words
② Beat splittingtarget 8s

Split the manuscript into ~8-second beats (each becomes one spread, matches animation video length). Estimator uses ~14 chars/sec for Dutch + sentence-aware breaks.

③ Beat previewno beats yet

Each row is one beat = one spread. Drag to merge/split manually after auto-split (Sprint 2).

④ Narrative timelinenot built

Single Claude pass over the full manuscript + bible. Produces a per-spread state JSON (location, who's present, pose start, pose end, props, phase color) that the image-gen composer reads when generating, so adjacent spreads flow without continuity breaks. Re-runs only when the manuscript or bible changes. Cost ~$0.20–0.50 for a full book.
